name: shipright-audit
description: Audits an existing app like an expert Staff Product Designer: a ranked pain map with evidence, Keeps, fixes and tests. Read-only.

interface.shortDescription: Expert UX audit for apps you already built
interface.longDescription: Walks every screen and core task, names what works, finds each pain with evidence and cause, and ranks what to fix first. Changes nothing.
defaultPrompt: Audit my app and tell me what to fix first.
Review the UX of this project. Don't change anything.
